subject: AWS CPPO: Reseller entitlement handoff + evidence runbook
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@salesvector.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS CPPO: Entitlement mapping + evidence runbook

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Per our call, we're lining up the entitlement handoff and the evidence pack required for the CPPO activation with AWS. Two quick asks to keep the activation on the July sprint:

1) Can you confirm the primary billing entity that will appear on the PO (legal name + tax ID)?
2) Please complete the short entitlement CSV (attached) with the subscriber SKUs you're expecting for the initial 3 customers so our Marketplace ops team can pre-provision mappings.

I've attached a preliminary entitlement mapping and an evidence checklist that AWS will expect for the private offer. Vanessa and Ben are copied — they'll own demo quota and the DocuSign sequence.

Two-week timeline goal: entitlement mapping by 7/05, evidence pack by 7/06, DocuSign to procurement by 7/07. If any blocker, flag here and we'll escalate to AWS partner ops.

Best,
Grace
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SV-demo-quota-request.csv (csv), SV-Entitlement-Mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: 2028-07-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: Entitlement mapping + evidence runbook

Grace — great plan. Quick answers:

- Legal name: SalesVector, Inc. / Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Jamie will fill the CSV and return by EOD 7/03.

One heads-up from our ops team: SaaSify likes consolidated evidence for multiple customers in one bundle. They'll want a single CPPO evidence package we can point AWS to. Can Redwood accept an evidence package that lists multiple subscriber accounts and maps SKUs to each? If so we'll bundle.

I'll attach our internal checklist.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Channel Sales
SalesVector

Alex — yes, Redwood's ops can accept a consolidated evidence package that enumerates multiple subscribers. Helpful if you include: (1) subscriber company name, (2) account ID or contact, (3) SKUs intended per subscriber, (4) expected monthly commit.

Ben — can you provision an extra demo quota slot for SalesVector the week of 7/10 (they asked for 2 simultaneous demo seats)? I've attached the demo quota CSV Grace sent — Alex, please confirm numbers.

I'll draft the DocuSign template once we have final entitlement mapping and PO entity.
